links.outcome: Reading grade level of ChatGPT responses to ACL surgery patient questions
links.effect: Full understanding of responses required 13.4 years of education, corresponding to a college sophomore reading level.
links.quote: According to the readability assessments, a full understanding of the ChatGPT responses required 13.4 years of education, which corresponds to the reading level of a college sophomore.

links.outcome: Accuracy and currency of ChatGPT answers to ACL reconstruction FAQs
links.effect: 6 of 10 responses unsatisfactory requiring substantial clarification; 1 adequate moderate clarification; 1 adequate minor; 2 satisfactory. Mean DISCERN score 41. Most responses were outdated.
links.quote: Of the 10 frequently asked questions entered into ChatGPT, 6 were deemed as unsatisfactory and requiring substantial clarification; 1, as adequate and requiring moderate clarification; 1, as adequate and requiring minor clarification; and 2, as satisfactory and requiring minimal clarification.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT-3.5's accuracy and readability when answering patient FAQs about ACL reconstruction surgery, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
